name: safeguards documented-subset recognition
description: src/safeguards (trellis-a97d): configuration-only inspection with explicit evidence levels. Recognition is a documented SUBSET: run refs (bun|npm|pnpm|yarn run <name>), check commands (biome/eslint; tsc --noEmit only; bun test/vitest/jest), repo-local path tokens (must contain a slash; URLs/flags/assignments/env vars/absolute paths excluded) — anything else stays unverified, never guessed. Broken-reference checks use pathExists (file OR directory; a core.hooksPath dir is a valid target) while surface detection uses fileExists. Evidence merges by rank structurally-wired > configured > unknown > absent. Executable runners (bun scripts/check-all.ts) stop CI-reachability: a check reachable only through one stays configured.
